threat_event: Ransomware spreads through the shared directory and data centers, encrypting the EHR, the Health Plan claims core, and the group file service, and forcing EHR downtime at all 9 hospitals
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One directory forest spans DC1 and DC2 and three divisions; server zones not separated by division; no clean recovery environment; vault restore of the EHR never tested (group gap 1)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G1; SYS-G3 DC1 and DC2; SYS-H1; SYS-H2; SYS-P1; group file service
likelihood_basis: EV-009 (one directory forest across DC1 and DC2); EV-017 (zones not separated); EV-021 (no full EHR restore in the log); EV-046 (5 to 7 day rebuild estimate)
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR; PAM; immutable vault at provider B; DC2 failover tested
treatment_plan: Clean recovery environment and full EHR restore test (POAM-012); isolate the highest-privilege directory tier and split data center zones by division (POAM-007); cross-division ransomware exercise (POAM-005)

threat_event: Compromise of medical devices or clinical OT across hospitals disrupts device function or alarms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 6,900 devices on unsupported operating systems; flat device networks at 4 hospitals; 37 vendor connections outside PAM (group gap 3)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-H3 medical devices and clinical OT
likelihood_basis: EV-054 (about 6,900 unsupported devices); EV-055 (flat device networks at 4 hospitals); EV-056 (37 connections outside PAM)
existing_controls: Clinical engineering inventory (81%); segmentation at 5 hospitals; device risk review at purchase
treatment_plan: Finish segmentation at 4 hospitals (POAM-015); move all vendor access into PAM (POAM-013); passive monitoring and scanning of device networks (POAM-006)
owner: Hospital System security and compliance lead

threat_event: A cross-division incident misses one or more regulator, customer, or investor notice deadlines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Notification matrix not exercised; College plan separate; each entity has different clocks (HIPAA, state, insurance commissioners, FSA, FTC, SEC) (group gap 8)
likelihood_basis: EV-012 (matrix not exercised; contacts missing); EV-082 (College plan separate); EV-092 (group risk interviews)
existing_controls: Group IR plan v5; disclosure committee charter
treatment_plan: Complete and exercise the multi-regulator matrix (P08); bring the College into the group plan (POAM-005, POAM-021)

threat_event: AI used in clinical, coverage, or academic decisions without adequate governance harms patients, members, or students
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Sepsis model live at 9 hospitals without local validation at 8 or a 92.210 review (group gap 6); UM triage pilot not yet before the UM committee; proctoring tool processes face video
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-H1 sepsis model; SYS-P1 UM pilot; SYS-E1 proctoring
likelihood_basis: EV-064 (validation at the flagship only); EV-068 (pilot not before the UM committee); EV-084 (proctoring contract)
existing_controls: Group AI Standard and AI council (2026)
treatment_plan: Validate the sepsis model at every hospital and document 92.210 steps (POAM-024); UM committee approval before any production use; proctoring review (P10)

threat_event: Student and trainee EHR accounts are misused or stay active after rotations end
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 4,500 accounts a year created from emailed rosters outside identity governance, password only, no end dates (group gap 4)
likelihood_basis: EV-042 (emailed rosters; no end dates; password only); EV-043 (affiliation agreements)
existing_controls: Unique accounts; privacy monitoring of record access
treatment_plan: Students and trainees into identity governance with end dates and MFA; secure roster feed from the College and outside schools (POAM-001, POAM-014)

threat_event: The College's systems are compromised because it is outside group common controls
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Separate directory; no MFA on the SIS and financial aid system; written risk assessment from 2022 (group gap 5)
likelihood_basis: EV-079 (MFA on email only); EV-078 (2022 risk assessment); EV-005 (College not on SYS-G1)
existing_controls: EDR on College servers (2025); email MFA
treatment_plan: Enforce MFA on the SIS (POAM-020); new written risk assessment (POAM-019); migrate the College to SYS-G1 by 2027-06-30

threat_event: A third-party remote access path (device or clinical vendor) is used to enter group networks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 140 device vendor connections, 37 outside PAM; vendor accounts with standing access
likelihood_basis: EV-056 (140 connections; 37 outside PAM); EV-008 (vendor accounts with standing access)
existing_controls: PAM for data center and EHR vendors; BAAs
treatment_plan: All vendor access through PAM with approval per session (POAM-013); vendor tiering in third-party risk

threat_event: The group identity platform is compromised, exposing every federated system
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single sign-on concentrates access; strong MFA and PAM in place
likelihood_basis: EV-005 (MFA; phishing-resistant for administrators); EV-008 (PAM); EV-010 (identity monitoring)
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant MFA for administrators; PAM; SOC monitoring of identity events
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for all remote workforce access by 2027-03-31; identity threat detection tuning

threat_event: PHI is disclosed between the Hospital System and the Health Plan beyond the minimum necessary
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written minimum-necessary protocols for routine feeds; full ADT segments sent (group gap 7)
likelihood_basis: EV-051 (full ADT segments); EV-004 (2023 addendum with no protocol)
treatment_plan: Written protocol for each routine feed approved by both Privacy Officers; reduce the ADT feed to the agreed elements (POAM-016)

threat_event: A hurricane disables DC1 and several Florida hospitals at the same time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DC1 and 6 hospitals are in Florida; DC2 is out of state
likelihood_basis: EV-037 (6 hospitals in Florida); EV-018 (DC2 about 300 miles away); EV-058 (2024 hurricane activation)
treatment_plan: Pre-landfall failover to DC2 in the hurricane plan; annual joint exercise

threat_event: Data is stolen from the group file service: patient, member, and student financial information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shares of three divisions in one service; College shares migrated with old permission groups; egress alerting basic
likelihood_basis: EV-036 (three divisions' shares; College permission groups); EV-010 (outbound volume rule only)
existing_controls: Encryption at rest; EDR; quarterly share reviews
treatment_plan: Re-permission College shares; egress alerting per share group; move financial aid documents into the SIS where possible

threat_event: Attackers operate unseen in device networks, vendor sessions, or College systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Monitoring gaps: 4 hospitals' device networks, 37 vendor connections, College networks and SaaS
likelihood_basis: EV-010 (sources not onboarded); EV-055 (device networks at 4 hospitals)
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC for data centers, cloud, identity, endpoints
treatment_plan: Extend SIEM and network detection to the gaps (POAM-004)

threat_event: Workforce members, students, or trainees view records without a need
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 34,000 users and 4,500 trainees a year; celebrity and coworker records
likelihood_basis: EV-041 (about 34,000 users); EV-042 (about 4,500 trainees a year); EV-044 (privacy monitoring case log)
existing_controls: Privacy monitoring tool with weekly review; sanctions
treatment_plan: Include student and trainee accounts in privacy monitoring once they are in identity governance

threat_event: The disclosure committee decides materiality late or describes an incident inaccurately
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: First cross-division exercise not yet held
likelihood_basis: EV-013 (charter; no cross-division exercise); EV-011 (exercise log)
treatment_plan: Include a materiality decision in the cross-division exercise (POAM-005)

threat_event: A cloud misconfiguration exposes Health Plan or imaging data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Guardrails in place; 2% of resources with deviations
treatment_plan: Auto-open exceptions for deviations older than 14 days (POAM-008)

threat_event: A compromised update from a clinical software vendor introduces malicious code
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many clinical vendors; updates tested for function, not tampering
likelihood_basis: EV-030 (no signed-update or SBOM terms); EV-045 (function testing in staging)
existing_controls: Vendor reviews; change board; file integrity monitoring
treatment_plan: Require signed updates and SBOMs in renewals; test updates in staging

threat_event: Business email compromise leads to a fraudulent payment from group finance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: High payment volumes; 2025 College mailbox compromise
likelihood_basis: EV-082 (2025 College mailbox compromise); EV-092 (payment fraud attempts); EV-005 (email MFA)
existing_controls: Call-back verification for bank changes; MFA for group email
treatment_plan: Extend call-back verification to the College; finance phishing drills

threat_event: College standards drift from group policy, so College staff follow weaker rules
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: College standards written before the acquisition; no supplement
likelihood_basis: EV-078 (2022 College standards); EV-023 (no College supplement)
existing_controls: Group policies adopted by the College in 2024
treatment_plan: Issue a College supplement and annual attestation (P06)
